updates.title: Needle 3 & Qwen 2.5 Offline AI
updates.description: Darling AI now runs completely on your device using dual offline models (Needle 3 + Qwen 2.5 0.5B) for private, high-speed responses with zero internet data.

updates.title: Synced Music Mini Player & Loader
updates.description: Now-Playing mini bar is now automatically synced with your song list, complete with smooth scrubbing, quick controls, and instant loading animations.

updates.title: Enhanced Video Player & 8D Audio
updates.description: Enjoy seamless gesture controls for brightness and volume, PiP background playback, and immersive spatial 8D audio processing.

updates.title: Zero-Data Offline File Sharing
updates.description: Transfer large movies, music albums, and full folders between devices at high Wi-Fi Direct speeds without using mobile data or cables.

updates.title: Smart Document Scanner & PDF Export
updates.description: Auto-detect document edges, apply crystal-clear contrast filters, and export multi-page receipts or notes directly to encrypted PDF files.

updates.title: Private Safe Vault & AdBlock
updates.description: Lock sensitive photos and private documents behind biometric authentication, backed by privacy-first DNS-over-HTTPS security.

updates.title: Battery & 120Hz Fluidity Optimization
updates.description: Optimized memory footprint for large folders, eliminated UI stutters on high refresh rate displays, and reduced background battery usage.
